description: HUMAN profile: how a discretionary intraday trader reads the tape, so it calls a trend sooner and tolerates a normal noisy day. Compared with config/regime_thresholds.json: 9 candles (45 min) instead of 12 before classifying, a 0.15% move from the open counts as direction (was 0.30%), the day-range zones are 40/60 (were 35/65), the last 3 of 5 candles (was 4 of 6) and 9 candles in three blocks (was 12) decide momentum and structure, and the volatility brakes are looser (one 0.8% bar or 0.15% stdev, was 0.5% and 0.10%). Still OUR choices, chosen by reasoning, NOT validated on real market data. Still needs 3 of 4 evidence items, none against.
